name: Tail Elongation
body:
Your tail is longer than that of a typical gnorri.

Prerequisite(s): Slitherspeed, Whiptail (Combat), gnorri.

Benefit(s): The reach of your tail attacks increase to 10 feet.

Normal: Your tail attacks only have a reach of 5 feet.
